crossRefs.note: You are my hiding place. You will preserve me from trouble. You will surround me with songs of deliverance.
He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.
I will say of Yahweh, “He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust.”
A man shall be as a hiding place from the wind, and a covert from the storm, as streams of water in a dry place, as the…
But you, Yahweh, are a shield around me, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.
For Yahweh God is a sun and a shield. Yahweh will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk…
My soul faints for your salvation. I hope in your word.
I wait for Yahweh. My soul waits. I hope in his word.
My soul longs for the Lord more than watchmen long for the morning, more than watchmen for the morning.

translations.web: You are my hiding place and my shield. I hope in your word.
translations.bsb: You are my hiding place and my shield; I put my hope in Your word.
translations.kjv: Thou art my hiding place and my shield: I hope in thy word.
translations.asv: Thou art my hiding-place and my shield: I hope in thy word.
